MTControlledVocabEventType.description: All \glspl{MTDataItem} with \gls{category} \mtmodel{EVENT} having       Controlled Vocabularies (Enumerations) will be added as sub-types of this       type which is mapped to the OPC/UA MultiStateValueDiscreteType. Otherwise,       either \mtmodel{MTString} or \mtmodel{MTNumeric} will be used. All       subtypes are direct representations of the MTConnect equivalent elements       that can be found in the MTConnect Part 3 \cite{MTCPart3} documents.
